name: Olympus Rising: Ragnarok
source:
You’ve found your place as a demigod among the Olympians, but a cold wind from the north carries a new threat to your door...

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Olympus_Rising:_Ragnarok]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
身为半神的你已在奥林匹斯众神之间觅得一席之地，然而凛冽的北风却将新的威胁吹到了你的门前……
